list.title: Libraries
list.description: Signed sets of processes, monitors, record types and dashboards from publishers you trust. You review a whole release before it is installed; nothing installs by itself.
list.noAccess: Designers and administrators review and install libraries.
list.emptyText: Upload a signed release as a .zip, or let an administrator add a Git source in library mode. A release is only accepted when an administrator trusts its publisher's key.
list.whoCanAct: Administrators trust publishers and add Git sources; designers and administrators upload and install releases.
list.name: Library

upload.staged: {{library}} {{release}} is verified and waits for your review
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB

conflict.otherLibrary: From another library or Git source

conflictHint.notFromLibrary: An item with this id exists in Steward and did not come from this library. Keep it, or replace it with the library's (the old version stays in the history).
conflictHint.changedLocally: Someone changed this item in Steward since it was installed. Keep the local version, or take the library's (the other stays in the history).
conflictHint.otherLibrary: This item comes from another library or Git source. Keep it, or uninstall the other one first.

origin.tooltipChanged: Installed from {{library}} {{release}} and changed in Steward since

abilities.markedNotChanging_other: {{count}} write steps marked as not changing anything – they also run in a dry run

connector.customCa: Trusts a CA certificate of its own

blockers.needsVersion: The release needs a newer Steward.
blockers.revokedKey: The release is signed by a revoked key.
blockers.notPrevious: Only the release installed before the current one can be rolled back to.
blockers.downgrade: An older release cannot be installed (downgrade).
blockers.rights: Some items need more rights than you have.
blockers.undeclaredProcess: Some items name processes the library does not declare.
blockers.expiredKey: The signing key expired: its releases are no longer installed. A rollback to the release installed before stays possible.

review.references: What it needs from this installation
review.referencesHint: Choose the platform or process each reference stands for. Your choice is kept for updates.
review.noPlatform: No platform of this kind that you may use
review.processRef: A local process the library calls
review.itemsHint: Everything this release brings. What each process can do is computed by Steward from its steps.
review.removedHint: Stays as a local item, detached from the library.
review.noRight: You may not change this item: someone with the right installs the release.
review.commentHint: Goes into the version history of the processes and the audit log.
review.needsAdmin: This release has connector types: only administrators install it. Platforms made from an earlier connector type are not changed.
review.revokedText: The publisher's key was revoked. This release cannot be installed.
review.requestMine: You asked to install this release on {{when}}. A second designer or administrator approves it.
review.requestOther: {{by}} asked to install this release on {{when}}. Check it and approve it to install it.

install.requested: Your request waits for a second person

discard.confirm: Discard {{name}} {{release}}? It can be staged again later.

detail.uploaded: Uploaded – Steward does not look for newer releases
detail.revokedText: The key that signed this release was revoked. Put the library on hold to stop its schedules, triggers and monitors and refuse new runs until a release with a good key replaces it.
detail.revokedTextAsk: The key that signed this release was revoked. An administrator can put the library on hold.
detail.revokedHeld: The key that signed this release was revoked. The library is on hold.
detail.heldText: Put on hold by {{by}} on {{when}}: its schedules, triggers and monitors are paused and new runs are refused.

hold.title: Put the library on hold?
hold.confirm: The schedules, webhook triggers and monitors of {{name}} are paused and new runs of its processes are refused until you lift the hold.
hold.liftConfirm: What the hold paused in {{name}} is turned on again, and its processes run again.

uninstall.title: Uninstall the library?
uninstall.confirm: The items of {{name}} stay as local items and lose their link to the library. Updates are no longer offered.

publishers.title: Trusted publishers
publishers.description: Releases are installed only when they are signed by a key you trust here. Compare each key's fingerprint with the publisher before you add it.
publishers.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} and its keys? Installed libraries stay; their updates are refused.
publishers.idHint: As in the library's manifest (publisher:), e.g. example-ops.
publishers.idInvalid: Lower case letters, digits and hyphens
publishers.name: Name
publishers.contactHint: Who to ask about a key (shown to administrators only).
publishers.librariesHint: Library ids this publisher may publish. Empty: any library.
publishers.emptyText: Add a publisher with its public key (ssh-ed25519, or a hardware key sk-ssh-ed25519). This Steward version has no built-in publisher key.

keys.keyHint: One OpenSSH public key line, as in the publisher's .pub file. Hardware keys (sk-ssh-ed25519) are recommended.
keys.keyInvalid: An ssh-ed25519 or sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com key line
keys.expiresHint: Optional. After this date new releases signed with it are refused.
keys.compare: Ask the publisher for the fingerprint (ssh-keygen -l -f key.pub) and compare it with the one Steward shows after adding.
keys.none: No keys – releases of this publisher are refused.
keys.retireConfirm: Releases staged or installed before stay valid; new releases signed with it are refused. Use this after the publisher rotated to a new key.
keys.revokeText: For a stolen or lost key: new releases are refused, and every installed release signed with it is flagged. You can then put those libraries on hold.
keys.removeConfirm: Remove the key {{fingerprint}}? Releases signed with it are no longer verified.

settingsCard.title: Libraries
settingsCard.text: Trust the publishers of shared procedure libraries and review their releases before they are installed.
